# SophieGermainWheel — where Sophie Germain primes can sit

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** proved in Lean · **Diagram:** [Sophie Germain primes](../../GRAPH.md#sophie-germain-primes)

Every Sophie Germain prime above 3 lies in the 6n-1 column; none ends in the digit 7; so above 5 its last digit is 1, 3 or 9.

## Published sources

Published work this node rests on or relates to; each entry says how.

- [Safe and Sophie Germain primes (Wikipedia)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Safe_and_Sophie_Germain_primes) — states that a Sophie Germain prime above 3 leaves remainder 2 on division by 3, and remainder 3, 9 or 11 on division by 20; this node's column and last-digit claims follow from those

## Claims

<a id="sophie_germain_mod_six"></a>
### `sophie_germain_mod_six`

Every Sophie Germain prime above 3 lies in the 6n-1 column.

```lean
/-- **Sophie Germain primes sit in the 6n-1 column.** Every Sophie Germain
prime above 3 leaves remainder 5 on division by 6. -/
def sophie_germain_mod_six : Prop :=
  ∀ p : Nat, sophie_germain p → 3 < p → p % 6 = 5
```

**Rests on:** [`Wheel6.prime_gt_three_is_candidate`](Wheel6.md#prime_gt_three_is_candidate)

**Proof:** `RNS.SophieGermainWheel.sophie_germain_mod_six_step` in [`RNSSolutions/SophieGermainWheel.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/SophieGermainWheel.lean); joined to its inputs in [`RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean)

<a id="sophie_germain_not_ends_in_seven"></a>
### `sophie_germain_not_ends_in_seven`

No Sophie Germain prime ends in 7.

```lean
/-- **No Sophie Germain prime ends in 7.** (Its double plus one would end in
5.) -/
def sophie_germain_not_ends_in_seven : Prop :=
  ∀ p : Nat, sophie_germain p → p % 10 ≠ 7
```

**Rests on:** no other node (Mathlib and the Vocabulary only)

**Proof:** `RNS.SophieGermainWheel.sophie_germain_not_ends_in_seven_holds` in [`RNSSolutions/SophieGermainWheel.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/SophieGermainWheel.lean)

<a id="sophie_germain_last_digit"></a>
### `sophie_germain_last_digit`

A Sophie Germain prime above 5 ends in 1, 3 or 9.

```lean
/-- **The last digit of a Sophie Germain prime above 5 is 1, 3 or 9.** -/
def sophie_germain_last_digit : Prop :=
  ∀ p : Nat, sophie_germain p → 5 < p → p % 10 = 1 ∨ p % 10 = 3 ∨ p % 10 = 9
```

**Rests on:** [`WheelOrder.prime_gt_five_digit_ok`](WheelOrder.md#prime_gt_five_digit_ok)

**Proof:** `RNS.SophieGermainWheel.sophie_germain_last_digit_step` in [`RNSSolutions/SophieGermainWheel.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/SophieGermainWheel.lean); joined to its inputs in [`RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean)
